Hello, thanks for checking out the about section!

This app is specifically designed for people with chronic illness or any mental/physical disability. Bramble is here to support you throughout daily tasks without having you over-exert yourself. We use the "Spoon Theory" to help you manage your day!

Adding tasks is simple and your average daily budget will be 12 spoons (or sardines). Once you complete a task depending on its difficulty: easy, medium, or hard a different amount of spoons will be spent, either 1, 2, or 3. Visually, the "spoon" counter will change dependent on how many tasks you have, a sardine skelly (skeleton) is signifying a spent spoon, a full one is an unused spoon.

The Mood Tracker on the top right corner is here to help you manage how many spoons you can add on top of your daily budget and for your own records. In the mood selection you'll see: >:(( :( :/ :) :)), log however you're feeling! If you happen to have a good day you are allowed to add a total of 8 extra spoons per day. On a bad day (worst-mood selected) you are suggested to take it easy for the rest of the day.

You shouldn't feel the need to complete any tasks if you're feeling unwell. Any unfinished (non-repeating) tasks will carry over to the following day so you'll have time to complete them in the future.

If you are over-exerting yourself by going beyond your spoon budget you are "borrowing" energy from the following day and you'll start the following day with less spoons. A spoon cost of +1 on top of the standard spoons costs will be added. This is to help you be selective about when/where to use up energy.

We hope this app helps people manage their energy and encourage rest when needed, without the feeling of "failure" for uncomplete tasks. Thanks for checking out Bramble :))
